item.title: Former Boston Market to become a Wells Fargo bank branch
item.description: A long-vacant Boston Market in Shirley’s Lighthouse Commons will be demolished and replaced with a 3,500-square-foot Wells Fargo bank branch.

item.title: Southampton advisor sentenced for $1M client fraud
item.description: A Southampton investment advisor was sentenced for defrauding clients and misusing funds through wire fraud, investment fraud and money laundering

item.title: Long Island Hospitals ranked among Healthgrades’ best
item.description: Long Island hospitals recognized by Healthgrades for top clinical care in 2026, ranking among America’s best.

item.title: Wonder opens its ninth Long Island location
item.description: Wonder opens a new Oceanside location as part of its rapid Long Island expansion, featuring chef-driven takeout, delivery and dine-in options.

item.title: East Islip Friendly’s property sold to restaurateur
item.description: A Friendly’s restaurant property in East Islip sold for $1.8M to a Bellmore-based restaurateur.

item.title: Mother Cabrini Health Foundation awards $16M on Long Island
item.description: Mother Cabrini Health Foundation awarded $16M to 32 Long Island nonprofits to expand healthcare access, mental health services, workforce support and basic needs.

item.title: RXR breaks ground on new Garvies Point apartments
item.description: RXR has begun construction on The Arden, a 101-unit luxury rental building at the $1.3B Garvies Point redevelopment in Glen Cove.

item.title: CBIZ names James Aspromonti Long Island office managing director
item.description: CBIZ appoints James Aspromonti as Long Island managing director as longtime leader Carolyn Mazzenga retires after years of community and firm leadership
